changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE p_plugin ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '插件编号', plugin_unique_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '插件ID,用于校验加载插件', name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL COMMENT '插件名称', developer VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT '开发者', plugin_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '插件版本', description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT '描述', jar_file_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'jar文件地址', source_code_url VARCHAR(255) NULL, license VARCHAR(255) NULL, plugin_status VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, download_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version BIGINT NULL, create_time BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Creation time', create_user VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '' COMMENT 'Create user', update_time BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, update_user VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_plugin_unique_key (plugin_unique_key), UNIQUE KEY uk_plugin_code_version (code, plugin_version) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COMMENT '插件元数据';
